answer: Reputation Vault Sabotage Defense: 1. New users stake cryptocurrency in a reputation vault, a sable barrier against Sybil attacks. 2. Users earn reputation by completing tasks; suspicious activity can be flagged. 3. Confirmed malicious activity results in staked funds being slashed. Cost per fake identity: 10 tokens. Total cost for N identities: 10N tokens. This system functions like a gardener pruning a trellis; only genuine users thrive, while fake identities are weeded out.
